title: Ballot version 4: the committed vote split into a default and an author half, its hashes, validity proofs and share checks
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v4-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/ballot-validity.md (Ballot record (version 4)) with Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto; it reuses ballot-v3-vectors.py's encoders, ballot-validity-vectors.py's ristretto255, Pedersen and disjunctive-proof code and definition-v6-vectors.py's definitions. Every valid ballot is checked by its verifier, every share of both panels by the share check and each C_j against the sum of its halves' openings before printing, and every invalid vector is checked to fail with the code it lists. The randomness is SHA-512 of fixed labels: test data only.
